entry.name: mc.combine~
entry.digest: Combine inputs into a multichannel signal
entry.description: The mc.combine~ object combines inputs (signals, multichannel signals, floats) into one multichannel signal. Unlike mc.pack~, every channel of an input multichannel signal will be included in the output.

arguments.name: number-of-inlets
arguments.description: The first argument specifies the number of inlets. If no argument is present, the object will be created with two inlets.

messages.name: list
messages.description: A list message will set constant values for multiple channels. For instance, a list of three items will set constant values for three consecutive output channels starting at the output channel corresponding to the inlet receiving the list.
